title: Socializing and parties – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: Socializing and parties – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Practice your English with this B2 listening test! Watch a video, answer questions, and check the transcript to improve your listening skills.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a series of street interviews about socializing and parties. For questions 1 to 6, choose the best answer (A, B, or C)
See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Based on Sophie's comments, which best describes her socializing style?

choices.html: She loves clubbing just as much as small gatherings.
She enjoys attending formal events with people she knows.

questions.prompt: What's true about the social event Sophie mentioned attending?

choices.html: They went to a friend's new home before going out for drinks.
They bought some presents for a friend's new place.
They met up at a bar for drinks and a chat.

questions.prompt: What is true about Liam's last night out?

choices.html: They went to a birthday party.
They planned to go clubbing but ended up at some bars instead.
They stayed out late and had a bit too much to drink.

questions.prompt: What can be deduced about Liam's socializing style?

choices.html: His friends can easily outlast him when partying.
He sees himself as a party animal.
He wishes he could go out more often.

questions.prompt: What is true about Olivia's last social event?

choices.html: They ended up at a party they hadn't been invited to.
They went to a friend's costume party.
They put together costumes in advance to attend a party.

questions.prompt: How did the party end for Olivia and her friends?

choices.html: They stayed until the very end.
They were asked to leave once the real guests realised they weren't invited.
They left when the party became more intimate and personal.
